parsed.explanation: No traveler-facing exposure is documented: no trans-specific offence, no police or border targeting, no facility or custody rule, no violence record. Sodomy is decriminalised and the criminal code is orientation-neutral, so no sexuality-law lever is shown. Weights against: a documented hostile social climate (invisible gay culture, 'gay demon' front page, bullying, an education official's referral threat), institutionalised discrimination (DV exclusion, no constitutional SO ground), no gender-recognition route producing documented frontier document disagreement, and sectoral laws of unclear reach to gender identity. Resident gaps (LGR, marriage, DV) are climate signals only. The visitor sphere is largely an open question rather than a proven harm, and advocacy operates without reprisal. Net: elevated but not high risk — hostility without documented state or organised exposure.
